note: Open and lightly wooded sites between a wooded ridge and Lake Waramaug Road; across the road a lawn and picnic strip runs down to the lake, and the east-edge sites look over it to the water. Sites 1-6 are for RVs and trailers only; many east-edge sites are tent-only. Cabins rent Fridays and Saturdays through Labor Day. No pets or alcohol. --Claude
summary: ctparks + ReserveAmerica + campground map read: $17/$27 confirmed; 76 sites, no hookups, 35 ft max (lengths 20-35), showers, water, dump, concessions; 2026 season May 22-Oct 12 written (stored closes 10-14 approximate); lakeview confirmed on imagery; note cleaned.
flags: WATERFRONT (stored lakeview, confirmed): the campground sits west of Lake Waramaug Road (a public road); between the road and the shore is an open lawn/picnic strip about 60-70 m wide (Esri imagery). The east-edge sites (e.g. 21, 29, 42, 50, 57-58, 62-63, 67 standard; 17, 25, 30, 36, 43, 51, 64, 65 tent-only) are about 80-100 m from the water across the road with open ground and scattered trees, so lakeview, not lakefront. ctparks: 'many overlooking the adjacent lake'.

SITE LENGTHS (ReserveAmerica Max Vehicle Length): RV/TRAILER ONLY sites 1-6 are 35 ft (6 at 30); STANDARD NON ELECTRIC sites 24 x 35 ft, 11 x 30, 4 x 25 (11, 26, 54, 67), 1 x 20 (52); popup/tent sites 20-35. About 45 RV-bookable sites take 23 ft+. RA lists 67 bookable sites + 6 cabins vs DEEP's 76.
